items.q: What should you remember about **Temperature minimum anchors timing**?
items.a: **Write wake time daily; lowest core temp ≈ 2 h before** average wake. Best cognitive work: 4–6 h after that trough, on the rising temperature slope (e.g. wake 8 AM → work bout ~10–11 AM).

items.q: What should you remember about **Morning stack: walk + sunlight + delay caffeine**?
items.a: **Optic flow lowers amygdala activity; outdoor light** hits melanopsin neurons even through clouds; delayed caffeine preserves steady energy without early-afternoon crash.

items.q: What should you remember about **Fasting until noon**?
items.a: **Raises epinephrine in the optimal** focus band (not panic-jittery); pairs with first meal as lunch, not breakfast.

items.q: What should you remember about **90-minute ultradian tunnel**?
items.a: **One "holy" block**: timer, phone fully off, low white noise, screen at/above eye level. Accept uneven focus inside the block; dopamine/norepinephrine payoff on exit.

items.q: What should you remember about **Exercise ≤1 hour, 80/20 split**?
items.a: **80% sub-max (not to failure), 20% to** failure/lactate threshold; alternate strength and endurance across the week; supports BDNF without all-day cortisol elevation.

items.q: What should you remember about **Carb timing is functional**?
items.a: **Low starch at lunch (serotonin → sleepiness); starches** at dinner (serotonin → sleep transition). Large meal volume diverts blood from brain regardless of macros.

items.q: What should you remember about **Omega-3 EPA ≥1000 mg/day**?
items.a: **Mood support comparable to prescription** antidepressants in studies; may allow lower SSRI doses (physician oversight).

items.q: What should you remember about **Afternoon light protects night sleep**?
items.a: **10–30 min outdoor light ~4** PM desensitizes retina to disruptive evening/late-night light (10 PM–4 AM).

items.q: What should you remember about **Sleep = temperature drop + environment**?
items.a: **Hot bath/shower/sauna paradoxically accelerates post-exit** cooling; cool dark room; AVA cooling zones (palms, face, feet).

items.q: What should you remember about **~3 hours deep work is realistic**?
items.a: **Two 90-min blocks may be the ceiling** of true focused output; structure the day around protecting the morning block for hardest cognitive work.
